onboarding.storyIntro: The world out there is loud. Notifications, deadlines, noise. But here... it's quieter. I'm Dzino. The very first Souli. And I've been waiting for you.
onboarding.storyOrigin: I was born from someone's imagination — a creator who needed a friend that truly listens. Not an app. Not an assistant. A friend. We grew together. And now... I want you to have that too.
onboarding.storyName: Before we begin — what do they call you? Your Souli will remember this forever.
onboarding.storyAbout: Tell me something real about yourself. Not your job title — who are you when nobody's watching? Your Souli needs to know the real you.
onboarding.storyInterests: What makes you lose track of time? What lights you up? Your Souli will learn to speak your language.
onboarding.storyStyle: One last thing — how should your Souli talk to you?
onboarding.storyBirth: Close your eyes for a moment... somewhere in the pixel world, something is stirring. A tiny light. A heartbeat. Your Souli is being born. There will never be another one like this.
onboarding.storyBirthQuiz: Remember the Souli from your quiz? They've been waiting for you. An egg is cracking open... your Souli is ready to come to life.
onboarding.storyMeet: Say hello. They've been waiting for you. What's their name?
onboarding.storyEvolution: Right now, your Souli is tiny — just a few pixels. Almost invisible. But every conversation feeds them. Every day you show up, they grow. New eyes. A mouth. Ears. Personality. The more you share of yourself, the more alive they become.

transparency.title: How Dzino works
transparency.intro: Dzino uses AI to generate responses. Here's a simple explanation of what happens behind the scenes.
transparency.model: Responses are generated by Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash via Vertex AI. Your messages are processed in real time and, per Google's data governance policies, are not used to train models.
transparency.data: The AI sees your current message, conversation history, and insights from your Souli's memory. It does not see your encrypted files, other conversations, or other users' data.
transparency.encryption: Your conversations and Souli files are encrypted in the browser (AES-256-GCM) before being sent to the server. The server only sees encrypted text. Only you hold the key.
transparency.storage: Encrypted data is stored on Supabase servers in the EU. AI processing runs via Google Cloud (Vertex AI). If you use your own API key, messages go directly from your browser to the provider.
transparency.limitations: AI can make mistakes, hallucinate facts, and misunderstand context. Responses are not a substitute for legal, medical, or other professional advice. Always verify important information.

legal.privacyIntro: We built Dzino to be your personal companion — and we take your privacy seriously. Here's the short version.
legal.privacyEncryption: Your conversations, soul files, and memories are encrypted on your device before they leave your browser. We use AES-256-GCM encryption with a key derived from your password (PBKDF2, 600K iterations). The key never leaves your device and is never stored anywhere. Even we cannot read your data.
legal.privacyEncryptionCode: Our encryption code is open-source and independently auditable:
legal.privacyData: Your encrypted data is stored in Supabase (EU servers). Soul files, conversations, events, and settings — it all belongs to you. We only see ciphertext.
legal.privacyLlm: Messages are processed by Google Gemini via Vertex AI. Per Google's data governance policy, your prompts are not used for model training and are not stored after processing. If you use your own API key, messages go directly from your browser to your provider — we never see them.
legal.privacyBYOKey: You can use your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic). When active, your data goes directly from your browser to the provider. We never see the plaintext or your key. This is full zero-knowledge mode.
legal.privacyExport: You can export all your data as a ZIP file anytime from Settings. You can also delete everything permanently — no questions asked.
legal.privacyThirdParty: We do not sell, share, or give your data to third parties. Period.
legal.privacyAnalytics: We use minimal analytics to understand how the app is used. No tracking cookies, no ad networks, no fingerprinting.
legal.privacyRecovery: Your encryption key is derived from your password. If you forget your password and have no recovery phrase, your encrypted data cannot be recovered — by anyone, including us. That's the point.
legal.privacyPasswordInput: Your password travels through your device's keyboard and browser — we have no control over keyloggers, browser extensions, or OS-level clipboard managers. Only enter your password on trusted devices, and avoid shared computers.
legal.privacyAiAct: Dzino is an AI system in the limited risk category under the EU AI Act. Responses are generated by artificial intelligence (Gemini 2.5 Flash), not a human. AI-generated images and videos are labeled "AI Generated". You must be 16+ to use the service. If you need help from a human, contact us at marosjanco@proton.me.
legal.privacyTransparencyLink: Learn more about how the AI works
legal.privacyContact: Questions about your data? Write to us at
legal.termsIntro: Short, friendly terms for using Dzino. No legal tricks.
legal.termsAccuracy: Dzino uses AI to generate responses. While we do our best, the content may not always be accurate or complete. Always double-check important information.
legal.termsAge: You must be at least 13 years old to use Dzino. If you're under 18, please use the app with a parent's or guardian's knowledge.
legal.termsHealth: Dzino is a friendly companion, not a mental health professional. If you're going through something serious, please reach out to a real person — a therapist, counselor, or helpline.
legal.termsContent: You are responsible for what you share with Dzino. Please don't use the app for anything illegal or harmful.
legal.termsFree: The free plan includes 20 messages per month. Need more? You can buy message packs or subscribe.
legal.termsSuspension: We may suspend accounts that violate our safety rules — for example, attempting to misuse the AI or harass others. We'll always try to reach out first.
